rationale: Price is at 99.5% of today's range and essentially at the all-time intraday high ($39.59), making a long entry pure momentum-chasing with asymmetric downside given the stock is already ~29% above prior close on a 2.32M-share float. A short is tempting given extreme extension above session VWAP ($30.00) and the 5-min ATR of only $0.30, but the last candle just broke to a new high on elevated volume, meaning momentum is still directionally up and a short faces the risk of further squeeze. With no news context to anchor a directional thesis, a wide spread (30 bps), and no historical analogs on file, there is insufficient edge to justify entry in either direction.
